subject: Security inspection boundaries & evidence sprint — Lumina order form
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lee <michael.lee@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security inspection boundaries & evidence sprint — Lumina order form

Michael — following up on the order form redlines we got this week. We want to confirm two operational items before we pass the security exhibit back to legal:

1) Pen test window and acceptable scope: are you expecting a full external + internal network test, or a scoped application + API test limited to the inference endpoints?
2) Evidence cadence: do you want a one-time evidence handoff (SOC 2 report + artifacts) or a recurring weekly/biweekly runbook for the first 90 days post-go-live?

I've attached a slightly updated security exhibit (v3) that narrows the inspection language and shows two options for pen test scope. If Lumina prefers a limited app/API test we can map required logs and staging access clearly.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm scope option A (app/API) or B (app/API + network)
- If A, Lumina provides a preferred 3-week pen test window (we'll give staging creds and a point of contact)
- If B, we'll need to coordinate cloud provider contact and an inspection checklist (we've noted required evidence in the attached spreadsheet)

Can we do a 30m sync today or tomorrow to lock this?

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-exhibit-draft_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: pen-test-requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@luminahealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Torres <ana.torres@luminahealth.com>, Lumina Health Legal <legal@luminahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security inspection boundaries & evidence sprint — Lumina order form

Thanks, Rohan — quick answers below.

1) Scope: we prefer option A (application + API only). We cannot authorize external network testing of our production VPC.
2) Evidence cadence: for the initial onboarding we want a weekly evidence packet for the first 60 days (SOC 2 report, relevant logs, and penetration findings for staging). After that, monthly updates are fine.

We can provision a 2-week staging window for your test team starting Oct 18; if you need the earlier window, we can try to accelerate but raises compliance questions.

Cc'd legal to confirm they can accept the revised language in v3.

—Michael
Michael Lee
Director, IT Security | Lumina Health

Appreciate the fast reply, Michael — option A works for us.

Vanessa / Legal: looping you in for redline guidance and to confirm we can accept a weekly packet for the first 60 days followed by monthly updates. We also need legal to confirm the pen test clause will be limited to staging and explicit that production network scanning is not permitted.

Logistics item: if Lumina can start the staging window Oct 18, we'll plan a pre-test kickoff (access, account list, test IDs) on Oct 15. I can host the kickoff and bring both infra and security owners from our side.

Action items (Rohan): I'll prepare a short runbook showing exactly which logs and snapshots we will provide each week (example: access logs, inference request traces, SOC 2 controls mapping). Sharing the runbook draft to the Drive link after this thread.

Rohan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lumina Health Legal <legal@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security inspection boundaries & evidence sprint — Lumina order form

Thanks, all — quick legal/ops note set from Redwood's side.

1) We can accept the application+API-only pen test limitation in the security exhibit. We'll add a sentence clarifying that all pen test activity must occur in the designated staging environment and that production access is strictly prohibited.
2) Evidence cadence: weekly packets for the first 60 days, then monthly, is acceptable. We'll include a list of required artifacts in the exhibit appendix (SOC 2 report link, redacted logs, summary of remediation items).
3) Paperwork: our standard amendment for the MSA/order form will reference the attached Pen Test Addendum (we'll attach the final PDF once legal completes formatting). Once Lumina confirms the Oct 18 staging window, we can proceed with the test kickoff calendar invite and a short NDA-addendum for the test engineers.

Please confirm Oct 18 is still the target and whether Lumina needs a supplier contact for cloud provider coordination (we can provide contacts but will need Lumina legal signoff).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Trust & Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: Pen Test Addendum (to be finalized) — PDF]
